verdict.rationale: Google Workspace ships an officially branded Admin SDK with documented Directory and Reports APIs. It also publishes machine-readable Discovery Documents that it says are used to build client libraries. However, the pack never shows actual language-specific client libraries or install and usage guides, so SDK depth is unproven. Apps Script is a low-code automation environment rather than an SDK. Missing for 10: documented official language client libraries (e.g., Python/Node/Java), SDK installation and quickstart docs, independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
